proposed.explanation:
TMGH's FY2025 results show strong and accelerating growth: earnings per share rose from 4.38 LE to 6.98 LE (+59.4%), gross profit grew from 14.00 billion LE to 20.86 billion LE (+48.9%), and net income attributable to parent shareholders jumped from 9.03 billion LE to 14.38 billion LE (+59.4%). Total equity expanded 21.4% to 157.71 billion LE, indicating a solid balance sheet. At the current price of 82.50 EGP, the trailing P/E is roughly 11.8×, which is reasonable for a company growing earnings at nearly 60% per year.

This fits your profile well: you are young, want fast growth, have a 10+ year horizon, no liquidity needs, and high risk tolerance. A high-growth stock with a moderate valuation is a good match for an aggressive, long-horizon investor.

I recommend buying 254 shares of TMGH (cost: 20,955 EGP), leaving 19,045 EGP in cash. This keeps TMGH at about 49.9% of your total portfolio value (42,040 EGP), just under the 50% diversification cap. Your existing 100 EFID shares (2,040 EGP, ~4.9% of portfolio) remain untouched.

Risks and caveats: (1) The evidence covers only one fiscal year; a single year of strong growth does not guarantee continuation. (2) No evidence was provided about EFID, so I cannot assess whether to add to or reduce that position. (3) The 2024 figures are restated, which may reflect accounting changes rather than pure operational improvement. (4) A P/E of ~11.8× is not cheap, and if growth slows the multiple could compress. (5) This is guidance, not a guarantee of returns. Consider reviewing the position after the next earnings report to confirm the growth trajectory is sustainable.
